description: Resolve an existing Jovie profile from a YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or Linktree URL or platform:handle. Only YouTube channels support extraction; unmatched Instagram, TikTok, and Linktree inputs return SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED. Bandcamp and custom websites return UNSUPPORTED_URL. Never creates a profile.

url-or-handle.description: YouTube channel URL or youtube:handle; Instagram, TikTok, or Linktree profile URL or platform:handle for existing Jovie profiles only. Other sites are unsupported.

name: lookup_creator
